description: Trial of the Sea Lion Find the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility and the Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance. Speak with the residents of Moonglade to learn clues as to where these items may be located. Form the Pendant of the Sea Lion from the two pendant halves. You need to be in proximity of the Shrine of Remulos to do this. Bring the joined pendant to Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade. Requirements: - Pendant of the Sea Lion - Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility - Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance
name: Trial of the Sea Lion
